svg.title: CTR2WUP estimated implementation progress: approximately 20 percent
svg.desc: Rough engineering estimate as of October 12, 2026, version 0.17.0. Three diagnostics were reported passing on v0.14.5; new result-file persistence, save updates and RomFS assets await console acceptance. Zero of seven full milestone acceptance checks are complete. No commercial game is playable yet.
svg.text: Rough estimate · 0 / 7 full milestones accepted · Commercial gameplay pending
